The '''Naboo Palace Guards''', also known as the '''Nabooian Royal Guards''' and nicknamed the '''"[[Pearl Hat]]s"''',<ref name="BlogSaN">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref> were a division of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Palace Guards were commonly stationed in and around the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
[[File:Naboo_Palace_Guard.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Baras Perosei]], ready for action]]
The Palace Guards served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for the ruling [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] and their court, though they also served and protected important figures such as [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector's]] appointed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], and were known to escort the representative to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and back. Unlike the [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]], this corps was largely made up of dedicated, experienced [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who had seen combat in offworld locales. Many Palace Guards had worked with the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] or various other planetary militia in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

These soldiers were known to be fiercely loyal to their charges and, although few in number, formed the backbone of the Royal Security Forces. As of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], one hundred and fifty soldiers comprised the Palace Guard. Commonly, they worked on average twenty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] and remained with the unit for five to ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] each. Though their training was somewhat below [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standard, the Palace Guards made up for it with zealous dedication to duty.

After the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Palace Guards adopted a darker uniform compared to the more colorful ones they had worn before the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invasion. During the Battle of Naboo most of them were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|main hangar]] and outside in the skirmish against the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] guarding the palace, who were supported by some [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]].
